# Truestead Law, LLC
> Full-service Florida law firm — Personal Injury, Real Estate, Wills/Estates/Trusts, Asset Protection, Elder Law, Probate & Trust Administration, Business & Succession, Construction Law, HOA & Condo Law, and International & Cross-Border. Founder Arthur Simpson, Esq. (Florida Bar #529265) — Attorney & Realtor®, CIPS (Certified International Property Specialist), and founder of GCRID (Global Coalition for Real Estate, Investment & Development). Serving Florida statewide; based in Ormond Beach, Volusia County. "Built to last. Planned to pass on."

## Core Practice Areas
- [Personal Injury](https://truesteadlaw.com/personal-injury): Florida accident & injury claims; car, truck, motorcycle, rideshare, boating, slip-and-fall, nursing-home neglect, wrongful death; contingency fee (no fee unless we recover); co-counsel litigation; free case review.
- [Real Estate Law](https://truesteadlaw.com/real-estate): deeds, title, homestead, ownership structure, 1031 exchanges, disputes.
- [Wills, Estates & Trusts](https://truesteadlaw.com/estate-planning): wills, revocable & irrevocable trusts, probate avoidance, homestead, powers of attorney, healthcare directives.
- [Asset Protection](https://truesteadlaw.com/asset-protection): Florida homestead, tenancy by the entireties, LLC & charging-order protection, exempt assets (annuities, life insurance, retirement); planning done before a claim arises.
- [Elder Law](https://truesteadlaw.com/elder-law): Medicaid & long-term-care planning, the five-year look-back, guardianship, incapacity documents.
- [Probate & Trust Administration](https://truesteadlaw.com/probate-administration): formal & summary administration, trust administration, creditor claims, clearing title for Florida estates.
- [Business & Succession Law](https://truesteadlaw.com/business-law): Florida LLC & corporate formation, operating and shareholder agreements, contracts, buy-sell agreements, business succession planning, commercial leases.
- [Construction Law](https://truesteadlaw.com/construction-law): Florida construction liens (Ch. 713), notice to owner, contractor disputes, defect claims, construction contracts.
- [HOA & Condo Law](https://truesteadlaw.com/hoa-condo-law): milestone inspections (F.S. 553.899), structural integrity reserve studies (SIRS, F.S. 718.112(2)(g), Dec 31 2026 outer deadline), board governance, covenant enforcement, owner records rights, buyer-side condo diligence.
- [International & Cross-Border](https://truesteadlaw.com/international-law): foreign buyers, FIRPTA withholding, Florida SB 264, U.S. estate tax on non-resident-owned property, EB-5 investor immigration through real estate (co-counsel), ancillary probate, cross-border estate planning; backed by GCRID.

## Online Document Kits (attorney-built, flat-fee)
- [All Document Kits](https://truesteadlaw.com/kits): the hub for every kit and subscription below.
- [Truestead Docs Membership](https://truesteadlaw.com/kits): $49/yr — unlimited updates and regeneration of purchased kit documents, ongoing document-portal access, priority email support.
- [Florida Estate Kit](https://truesteadlaw.com/florida-estate-kit): Florida-specific estate documents online — DIY from $129 or attorney-guided. Real Florida documents, plain English.
- [Florida LLC Kit](https://truesteadlaw.com/llc-kit): Florida LLC formation online — Articles, operating agreement, resolutions, EIN & Sunbiz guides. $149 DIY / $499 attorney-formed / $1,200 foreign owner, plus $125 state fees; registered agent $99/yr.
- [Florida Deed Shop](https://truesteadlaw.com/deeds): quitclaim ($129/$349), Lady Bird enhanced life estate ($199/$399), warranty (attorney $399), deed into trust or LLC ($149/$349) — with recording guides and doc-stamp worksheets.
- [Florida Lease Shop](https://truesteadlaw.com/leases): Ch. 83-compliant residential lease ($129/$349), commercial NNN lease ($299/$799), and the $79 Landlord Notice Pack (3-day, 7-day, and deposit-claim notices with service guide); attorney lease tiers include the notice pack.
- [Trademark Registration](https://truesteadlaw.com/trademark): attorney-of-record federal trademark filing — $699 flat + USPTO $350/class (vs LegalZoom's $899); search & written opinion alone $199; trademark monitoring $149/yr.
- [18 & Protected (FREE)](https://truesteadlaw.com/18-and-protected): free Florida legal packet for young adults 18–25 — Health Care Surrogate, HIPAA authorization, Durable Power of Attorney, and FERPA waiver, with a signing checklist. For parents of new 18-year-olds / college students.
